about: Neonobility. Neons are the old money of the expansion: they sleep through decades in hibernation sarcophagi and arbitrage time itself, guided by heritarchists who read family lines half as data, half as horoscope. Virtuals are young Neons who gave up on biology for synthetic or holographic bodies. Fluencers are Neon offspring, or people who say they are, who stream everything.

neon_sleeper.about: sleeps through decades in a sarcophagus and buys land before it is worth anything

heritarchist.name: Magister Notary Augias Pfennig
heritarchist.about: heritarchist to the {neon_family} family: reads family lines across hibernation cycles; bills for it

virtual_heir.name: Karen Asquine-Kraal
virtual_heir.about: young Neon who gave up biology: a holographic body, a 300-kilo projector, opinions about freight rates

fluencer.name: Brisa
fluencer.about: streams everything; claims a Neon family that may not claim her

fluencer_manager.name: Lorisa
fluencer_manager.about: {fluencer}'s twin and manager: negotiates the rates while her sister films; never on camera

neon_family.name: Kraal
neon_family.about: the Neon family {neon_sleeper} sleeps for; written as 'the Kraal family' or 'a Kraal heir' in texts

neon_sleeper_carried.about: the captain carried {neon_sleeper} asleep to Delta

neon_land.about: {neon_sleeper} bought the land next to {geod}'s Row and went back to sleep

virtual_friend.about: the captain charged {virtual_heir} for the passenger, not the projector

fluencer_streamed.about: {fluencer} streamed the captain's ship to nine million followers

fluencer_exposed.about: the captain told {fluencer} that the {neon_family} family has never heard of her

neon.sarcophagus.title: Sleeping cargo
text: {neon_sleeper} wants passage to Delta, asleep. She travels in a hibernation sarcophagus, as cargo, and pays as first class.

Her heritarchist, {heritarchist}, rides along awake. Over dinner he reads your family line and announces that it is distinctly haulerish, therefore expect haulerish outcomes. He bills her for the reading.

choices.say: Decline: sleeping cargo makes the crew nervous

neon.sarcophagus.wake.title: Eleven minutes awake
neon.sarcophagus.wake.text: At Delta the sarcophagus opens for eleven minutes. {neon_sleeper.short} buys every field next to {geod}'s Row, signs, tips you in a currency that has not existed for a century, and goes back to sleep. Her instructions to {heritarchist.short}: wake her in thirty years, when the land is worth something.

neon.virtual.title: Weightless
neon.virtual.text: {virtual_heir}, a young Neon who gave up on biology, books passage as a holographic body and a projector. The body weighs nothing. The projector weighs three hundred kilos and wants a power line of its own. {virtual_heir.short} would like to discuss the freight rate for something that weighs nothing.

choices.say: Charge for the passenger, let the projector ride free

neon.fluencer.title: Live from your hold
neon.fluencer.text: {fluencer} boards with three cameras and no ticket. She says she is a {neon_family} heir and that your ship is giving authentic hauler. Her feed has nine million followers. Your coffee machine has never been filmed before and is not handling it well.

variants.text: {fluencer} boards with three cameras and no ticket. She says she is a {neon_family} heir. You have carried the {neon_family} family, asleep, and {heritarchist.short} read you every name on the family line over dinner, twice. Hers was not one of them.

choices.say: Tell her you have met the family
Put her off at the next dock
